title: Chart Selection Matrix
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Data Visualization
Instructional Design
Chart Selection
description: An interactive decision matrix that crosses five data types (categorical, time series, distribution, relationship, part-to-whole) with five question types (compare, change, composition, distribution, relationship) to recommend a chart type. Learners click a chart to see when to use it and a sample chart, toggle advanced chart types, and practice choosing the right cell for nine data scenarios.

educational.topic: Choosing a chart type from the data type and the question
learningObjectives: Select the most appropriate chart type based on the nature of the data and the question to be answered
Identify the data type and the question type in a short data scenario
Recognize chart types that are commonly misused and name a safer choice
prerequisites: Familiarity with bar, line and pie charts

controls.description: Click a chart in the matrix to select it and show its guidance and sample chart
Hover over or tab to a chart to preview when to use it

controls.label: Show advanced charts
controls.description: Adds Box Plot, Violin, Heatmap, Bubble and Treemap to the matrix

controls.label: Practice Scenario / Next Scenario
controls.description: Presents a data scenario; the learner clicks the matching cell and gets feedback with graduated hints

controls.label: Show Me
controls.description: Redraws the sample chart with new sample data

pedagogical.pattern: Decision matrix lookup with scenario practice
pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore the matrix, then apply it to short scenarios with immediate feedback and graduated hints
keyQuestions: What kind of data do you have?
What do you want the reader to see?
Which charts are often misused, and why?
commonMisconceptions: A pie chart is a good way to compare values
Any data set can go in any chart type
A dual axis chart shows that two measures are related
assessmentOpportunities: Nine practice scenarios with feedback inside the MicroSim
Learners justify a chart choice for their own content in one sentence
